user.title: Set up LED Color for Hue
user.description: Address (IP) of your Hue Bridge. If the official Hue integration is installed it is already filled in.

link.title: Press the bridge button
link.description: Press the round button on top of the Hue Bridge ({host}) now, then click «Submit» within 30 seconds.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the bridge. Check the address and that the bridge is powered.
error.link_button: The button has not been pressed (yet). Press it and submit again.
error.not_hue_bridge: No Hue Bridge answers at this address.
error.bridge_v1: This is an old round bridge (V1). LED Color needs the square bridge (V2) or the Bridge Pro.

abort.already_configured: This bridge is already set up in LED Color.
abort.reauth_successful: Re-linked – LED Color is running again.

bridge_error.message: The Hue Bridge reported an error: {error}

no_colors.message: Please give at least one color.

not_gradient.message: {name} cannot show a gradient. Give a single color.

too_many_colors.message: {name} supports at most {max} gradient colors, you gave {count}.

no_target.message: Please choose a Hue light (light.…) or a gradient sensor (sensor.…_verlauf) as target.

unknown_target.message: {entity_id} is neither a Hue light nor a LED Color gradient sensor.

powerup_custom.message: «Custom» can only be configured in the Hue app.

set_gradient.name: Set gradient
set_gradient.description: Sets a color gradient on a Hue gradient light (Signe, Lightstrip Gradient, Play Gradient) and turns it on.

farben.name: Colors
farben.description: Colors in order, e.g. #2f63ff, #16b8f0, #ff8a00. At least 2 for a gradient (at most what the light supports, usually 5). A single color = whole light one color.

modus.name: Mode
modus.description: How the colors are spread. Empty = smooth.

uebergang.name: Transition
uebergang.description: Duration of the change in seconds. Empty = bridge default.

copy_gradient.name: Copy gradient
copy_gradient.description: Copies the colors of one Hue light exactly to other lights. Mirrored = reversed order.

von.name: From light
von.description: Light or gradient sensor to copy from.
